title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: M.C.A - Middle Class Ambala
desc: Nani, a middle-class boy with an eidetic memory, helps save his sister-in-law from a goon. Meanwhile, he also tries to convince his girlfriend's father to marry her off to him.

title: Gandhi Kannadi
desc: An event organizer orchestrates a grand diamond jubilee for an elderly gentleman. This profound assignment facilitates an unexpected journey involving sentimental aspirations and sincere bonds.

title: Indru Netru Naalai
desc: Friends Elango and Pulivetti stumble upon a time machine and exploit it for personal gain. Things take a turn when they alter a gangster's fate, leading to unforeseen and dangerous consequences.

title: Raja Raja Dhan
desc: Raja, a visually impaired young man, steps in to save Lucky from a gangster's deadly pursuit. Subsequently, touched by his unwavering courage and kindness, Lucky falls in love.

title: Nandhan
desc: Koppulingam, a man from the upper caste, plays the game of politics in order to stay in power when the village council unexpectedly becomes a reserved constituency.

title: Kalyana Samayal Saadham
desc: Raghu, a software engineer, faces several challenges in his arranged marriage as he suffers from erectile dysfunction and tries to find a solution to his problem.

title: Thiru Thiru Thuru Thuru
desc: Arjun and Archana manage to find a baby for a crucial advertisement in order to help their boss from a financial crisis. However, they are shocked when they learn that the baby is an abductee.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Naalu Policeum Nalla Irundha Oorum
desc: Four policemen lead a peaceful and ideal life in a model village. However, their world is turned upside down when they are transferred to a riot-prone village.

title: Mandela
desc: In a small village, two political parties compete in the local elections and are ready to win at any cost. In a twist of fate, the single deciding vote comes down to a small-time barber.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

title: Manam
desc: Bittu, a six-year-old, loses his parents in an unfortunate car accident. Thirty years later, he comes across two collegians who look exactly like his late parents' young selves.

title: Rangasthalam
desc: A young man suffering from a hearing defect rises up against a corrupt local leader along with the help of his fearless older brother. Together, they defy tyranny in a fight for justice and freedom.

title: Cadaver
desc: When two surgeons mysteriously get murdered by Vetri, a prisoner, the responsibility of locating his accomplice falls on the shoulders of a pathologist.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.
